title: Lock Scripts, Type Scripts, and script groups

questions.prompt: What does a Lock Script primarily control?
questions.explanation: Lock Scripts define ownership or spending authorization.

questions.prompt: What does a Type Script primarily control?
questions.explanation: Type Scripts validate creation, transformation, and destruction rules for typed Cells.

questions.prompt: What does script exit code 0 normally mean?
questions.explanation: A zero exit code signals successful script validation.
